upstream_release_metadata.note: The official v2.12.0 tag contains inconsistent internal version labels. The executable npm artifact is therefore pinned and independently validated instead of inferred from those labels.

installation_method: npm exec with exact package version and bundled template generation
network_behavior: The installer contacts the npm registry for the exact pinned package. The generated Python search engine uses local data and the Python standard library.
supply_chain_controls: GitHub workflow token removed from the installer process
Python compilation and functional smoke tests
mandatory_gates: human approval before publish, merge or deploy
rollback: restore .pefy/backups/ui-ux-pro-max/<timestamp> or revert the installation commits
kill_switch: disable the UI UX Pro Max Sync workflow and revert/remove generated capability files
upgrade_rule: change npm_version_pinned only after provenance review, integrity verification and successful validation in a controlled branch
